extraAttempt.scope: One explicit extra attempt after two pre-run ENV_FAILUREs; not a reset of case retry history. If it succeeds, continue unchanged c-04 through c-18 in original plan order. If it fails, STOP_BATCH.

unchangedRules: Read-only; no booking forms or slot clicks; S0 immediate batch stop; 500s/50 model/40 Google per run; >=5min gaps; 403/503/429/busy 15min cooldown once; all historical budgets retained; no witness renewal.
